summary: iter-59 · Independent verification of the three architecture features approved from external review — (a) formal feature-schema versioning with train/serve gating, (b) EA-native pre-submit broker-constraints preflight (freeze/stops + trade_mode), and (c) immutable append-only trade_events event stream + GET /api/trades/events endpoint. Confirmed EA bumped v1.48→v1.49 with a NEW trade_mode field in symbol_specs, and every LATEST_EA surface bumped to 1.49 (backend routes/bot_routes.py, routes/diagnostic_routes.py, routes/setup_routes.py + frontend Accounts.jsx, EaVersionStrip.jsx). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter59_review_verification.py (15 HTTP+source+DB tests, 3.17s, 15/15 pass) that covers what the existing pure-unit /app/backend/tests/unit/scalp/test_iter59_feature_schema_events.py (13 tests, 0.33s, 13/13 pass) does NOT — specifically: (1) GET /api/trades/events returns 422 when neither trade_id nor decision_id is provided AND when unauthenticated (returns 401/403); (2) two different users (A and B) each see ONLY their own scoped events even when the SAME decision_id was seeded for both — chronological ordering by ts_ms preserved, mongodb _id projected out; (3) trade_events.append() creates all three required indexes on first insert ((decision_id,ts_ms), (trade_id,ts_ms), (event_type,ts_ms)) — verified via pymongo index_information() after triggering a real motor async append; (4) trade_events.build() populates schema_v=1, event_id (32-char hex), ts_ms, occurred_at, source=scalp_engine and all 5 correlation IDs; (5) EA source #property version=1.49 AND #define EA_CLIENT_VERSION=1.49 in perfect coherence, AppendSymbolSpec() calls SymbolInfoInteger(sym,SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE) and JSON-serialises trade_mode alongside the existing stops_level_points/freeze_level_points; (6) every backend/frontend LATEST_EA surface pins the literal '1.49' (grepped through routes/*.py + Accounts.jsx + EaVersionStrip.jsx); (7) scalp/model.py retrain() explicitly skips decisions where feature_schema_version != FEATURE_SCHEMA_VERSION and load_persisted() gates on the artifact stamp matching; (8) scalp/engine.py _submit_live has an EA-native constraint block that assigns reject_stage='pre_submit_broker_constraints' with all 5 MT5 SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE branches (0/1/2/3/4) and releases the broker_submission_slot on reject; (9) engine emits ALL 8 lifecycle event types (DecisionCreated, RiskApproved, OrderIntentCreated, BrokerSubmitted, BrokerRejected, PositionOpened, PositionClosed, FinancialApplied) and protection_guard.py emits ProtectionPlaced on broker-confirmed stop resolution. Full pytest suite: `pytest tests/ -q` → 2215 passed, 2 flaky, 7 skipped, 21 warnings in 456.93s (7m37s). The 2 failed tests (test_iter24_per_account_bot_cfg::test_start_stop_is_scoped_per_account 409-vs-200 and test_iter57_phase1_hardening::test_six_failed_logins_return_429 lockout-not-hit) are pre-existing suite-ordering flakes UNRELATED to iter-59 changes — both PASS in isolation (verified via targeted rerun: 2/2 pass in 2.40s) and neither touches feature_schema, trade_events, or the EA v1.49 surfaces. No live-account modifications; new trade_events seed docs used TEST_iter59_* decision_ids and are torn down in each test's finally block.

critical_code_review_comments: OK · Feature schema (a): /app/backend/scalp/feature_schema.py exposes FEATURE_SCHEMA_VERSION=1 + FEATURE_SCHEMAS immutable tuples. scalp/features.py FEATURE_KEYS = list(current_keys()) — single source of truth. scalp/model.py vectorize(features, schema_version) returns None for unknown versions (99, 'junk'), retrain() explicitly skips docs where feature_schema_version != CURRENT, load_persisted() refuses artifacts with mismatched schema, and the trained artifact stamps feature_schema_version=FEATURE_SCHEMA_VERSION. Zero training/serving-drift risk when the schema evolves.

OK · EA-native preflight (b): scalp/engine.py::_submit_live @L1383-1426 reads symbol_specs.point/stops_level_points/freeze_level_points/trade_mode from account snapshot, computes SL and TP distances in POINTS (not pips) — correctly matching MT5's SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL / SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL units — and rejects the decision with reject_stage='pre_submit_broker_constraints' when min(sl_pts, tp_pts) < max(stops_level_points, freeze_level_points). All 5 SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE branches implemented (0=disabled 1=long-only 2=short-only 3=close-only 4=full); implicit close-only (3) reject-branch also correct since the 4/1/2 allow-list is exclusive. Slot is released via release_broker_submission_slot() on reject.

OK · Event sourcing (c): trade_events.py::build() validates event_type ∈ EVENT_TYPES (else ValueError), stamps schema_v=1, generates a fresh event_id UUID hex, includes ts_ms + occurred_at + all 5 correlation IDs. append() is insert-only (no update/delete path) and creates the 3 required indexes on first-invocation via the module-level _indexed flag. GET /api/trades/events @ trade_routes.py L19 registered BEFORE any /trades/{id} catch-all — verified by request working with query params only. Response strips mongodb _id via projection ({_id:0}), sorts by ts_ms ascending, capped at limit ∈ [1,500]. user_id scoping is enforced from the authenticated cookie session — cross-user reads verified to return only owned events.

OK · EA v1.49 (b/c): #property version + #define EA_CLIENT_VERSION are the single-source-of-truth macro at /app/backend/static/EmergentTradingBridge.mq5 L178+L185, both = '1.49'. AppendSymbolSpec() @L867 reads SymbolInfoInteger(sym, SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE) and includes it in the symbol-specs JSON block. models.py::BridgeSymbolSpec.trade_mode is Optional[int]=None → backward-compatible with in-flight EA v1.48 heartbeats that omit the field (verified via TestBridgeSymbolSpecTradeMode). Backend LATEST_EA='1.49' in bot_routes.py L1099 + diagnostic_routes.py L24, ea_latest_version='1.49' in setup_routes.py L202. Frontend LATEST_EA_VERSION='1.49' in both pages/Accounts.jsx L10 and components/EaVersionStrip.jsx L8.

OK · Engine lifecycle emits are complete: engine.py L1039 (DecisionCreated always), L1044 (RiskApproved when verdict=live_traded), L1428 (OrderIntentCreated pre-submit), L1486 (BrokerRejected on trade.blocked), L1508 (BrokerSubmitted post-submit), L1623 (PositionOpened in on_trade_opened), L1758 (PositionClosed in on_trade_closed) and L1763 (FinancialApplied in on_trade_closed). protection_guard.py L260 (ProtectionPlaced on broker-confirmed stop). All emits are wrapped in _bg() background-append so a slow Mongo write never blocks the hot-path — insert failures are also try/except'd inside protection_guard to keep the sweep loop healthy.

OBSERVATION · BrokerAccepted is in EVENT_TYPES but the engine currently emits BrokerSubmitted instead (broker ack is treated as PositionOpened). Not a bug — the emit set matches the actual lifecycle transitions supported by the MT5 async fill contract (no separate accept vs open ack) — but future EA versions that split the two should upgrade _submit_live to emit BrokerAccepted before PositionOpened.

OBSERVATION · The full-suite 2 flakes are not iter-59 regressions. iter-58 (green) and this run (2 flakes) differ only in test-suite ORDER because pytest collection is filesystem-sorted and new test files can shift execution position.
